title: Pale Nightmares: The Brutal State (after Thomas Cole)
description: The second in a series of works harnessing the Hudson Valley River School movement and paintings as a lens to grapple with, and attempt to navigate, our current moment in history. Included in: This is America: Art USA Today , at the Kunsthal KAdE museum of modern and contemporary art, Amersfoort, Netherlands. Featured and reviewed in Patricia Sweetow Gallery .
medium: Braided cotton cord, nylon cord, paracord, fabric
